_why: Role track for 3D CAD DESIGN, the first pack authored for a trade with no NCO code. fam_cad_design_3d binds the RVM-minted jd_rvm_3d_cad_designer at job-domain specificity 50; 2D phrases stay on fam_cad_drafting and the twelve other 3118 occupations on fam_draughting, so a draughtsman never meets 3D depth and a modeller never meets tracing questions.
_scope: 3D MECHANICAL DESIGN, NOT 2D DRAFTING, by CEO Launch Plan Pack v1 sheet 4 (RULED 2026-11-02). A worker who only edits drawings under a senior, traces, or runs AutoCAD 2D all day is a 2D draughtsman and belongs on qp_cad_drafting: 'AutoCAD only, 2D hi karta hoon' routes there, and the software question's escape chip ('Koi aur software') plus the work-area escape keep a 2D-only worker from claiming 3D rungs. The separating questions (senior/lead) are what stop a model-copier from printing as a designer.
_depth: THE TIER GATE IS design_experience, and it is asked SECOND (after nothing — there is no disambiguator split in this pack; the trade picker is shared). It cannot be experience_years from qp_universal: phase order runs occupation_specific BEFORE universal_tail, so the universal answer does not exist yet when these items are selected. Its options carry value_number ONLY. pack-registry.service.ts resolves valueText ?? valueNumber ?? valueBool, so adding a value_text would make the answer a STRING; every gte below would then compare a string to a number, compare() returns null, and the predicate is false forever. A permanently-false ask_if is a question that is never asked, silently -- the #776 defect that sat in qp_welding for the life of the pack.
_budget: MAX_ENGINE_ASKS is 28 and qp_universal spends 8. Easy is 2 trade items + 3 confirms (only the confirmed rungs are ever asked their confirm, so a trainee sees 2); Medium adds 2 (software, work area); Advanced adds 3 (depth, tolerance, industry). Worst case 2 + 1 + 2 + 3 = 8 occupation asks + 8 universal = 16, retries included still inside the budget with room for the offer turn.
_sheet: SECTION B IS READ OFF CEO LAUNCH PLAN PACK v1 SHEET 4 (not a ratified page — Track A #4 is a new trade). Section title 'Design, software & capability'. Its rows are 3D Software, Work Area, Depth in Software, Tolerance / GD&T and Industry, and every row has exactly one question here that fills it. Headline per sheet 4: role, level, years, software, work areas.
review_note: v1 (CEO Launch Plan Pack v1, Track A #4): new trade. Easy/Medium/Advanced tiers; 6-band experience; sheet-4 level ladder (Trainee/Designer/Senior Designer/Lead/Supervisor); sheet-4 software + work-area sets (Medium); Advanced depth/tolerance/industry rows; 3 separating confirm items (easy, gated on rung). No fresher/ITI block (Track A supply is RVM alumni + poly/BTech; the shared ITI block is Track B packs only). No separate Other controller question (no controllers on this trade). Drafted for owner review (Prakash).
